propositions: _metric_invoke invokes scc without --by-file flag, causing scc to return language summaries with empty Files arrays instead of per-file entries
_scc_files consumes only per-file entries from scc JSON Files array and yields no matches when Files is empty, preventing any over-cutoff metric matches from being emitted

The oversize-LOC detector contract promises that a present scc run emits a normalized match for every file exceeding the configured code-line cutoff, but the omitted --by-file flag prevents this from ever occurring

Adding --by-file to the scc invocation in _metric_invoke restores the ability to detect and emit per-file metric matches for files above the LOC threshold without changing thresholds, the Code field, or fail-open semantics

Grounding metric backend and the separate metrics analyzer in src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/scc_loc.py are both scc per-file consumers; the analyzer was already fixed (rapid-cuboid-velvetcrab) and both must explicitly request --by-file for correct operation
